## Brief
Fix the ledger's render-and-import round trip so that stored prose containing a line that starts with `## ` survives, and main's suite goes green. Ticket SPD-076 (`spud ticket show SPD-076`) has the evidence and the three affected notes: ledger/teams/BADS-036/Marfona.md, Roseval.md and Sarpo.md.

**The failure.** On main, `python3.14 -I -S -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests -p 'test_acceptance.py'` fails twice in CutoverReadinessTest: `test_round_trip_differs_only_in_formatting` (a re-render adds a blank line before `## Shared context` in Marfona and Roseval), and the KNOWN_PROSE_KINDS check (tests/test_acceptance.py lines 66 and 389-391: the importer keeps `## Shared context` as a prose section of a kind it does not know). The cause: a member's brief contains a `## ` line; the render writes it under the note's `## Brief`; the import splits the note at every level-2 heading.

**What to build.** Prefer option (a): the render and the import delimit a note's sections only by the headings its layout owns (the ticket and member layout keys near the top of bin/spud_ledger.py, lines 100-115; `split_document`, `ticket_layout`, `member_layout`, `check_section_layout`, `store_prose_if_needed`, `import_ticket_file`, `import_member_file`, `accept_ticket_edit`, `accept_member_edit`, and the render side `body_with_sections`, `ticket_section_text`, `member_section_text`), so prose may contain any heading and round-trips byte for byte. Fall back to option (b), refusing or demoting a `## ` line at write time with a clear message, only if (a) cannot keep the disaster-recovery import exact; if you take (b), existing rows must still render and import exactly as stored. Either way:
- The three stored BADS-036 rows are not edited, by hand or by `member edit`.
- Do not add `Shared context` to KNOWN_PROSE_KINDS or loosen any acceptance assertion to get green: the test is right.
- Add unit tests: a brief, a result, an outcome and ticket prose each containing `## ` lines (including one that matches a real section name, such as `## Outcome`, inside a Brief) render, import and re-render byte for byte, and hand-edit detection (render exit 6, `spud import --file`) still sees a real edit of such a note.
- Add the scan the ticket asks for: a test that no stored prose in the ledger fixture the acceptance test uses breaks the round trip.
- Keep the change small and local. SPD-065 moves this code into a package right after, so no reorganising here.

**Verification.** The full suite in this worktree, `python3.14 -I -S -m unittest discover -s tests -t tests` (732 tests on main, about eight minutes; run it in the background and wait), green with zero failures, and the acceptance file on its own. Report the counts before and after. No hook code changes, so no timing run.
